world_concept:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original hand-painted fantasy continent map for Asterveil Fateweave, world แอสเตอร์เวล. Generate ONE landscape 16:9 painting, requested 3840x2160. No writing, no letters, no numerals, no legend, no UI, no frame, no compass, no watermark. Reference attached keyart ONLY for painterly material/color language: blue-violet masonry, champagne-gold arches, cyan falls, soft brushwork, readable small silhouettes. Invent entirely original geography.
A whole coherent asymmetric continent fully surrounded by deep teal ocean, all coastline inside frame with generous water margins, high bird's-eye oblique cartographic view, not a ground landscape. Six clearly distinct contiguous regions separated by natural ridges/rivers: 
1 southwest corner frontier peninsula about x12-40%,y49-87%, moss and teal green, warm pale trails. This ENTIRE corner is chapter ONE, containing exactly ten DISTINCT readable miniatures, spaced out along a winding trail within the same peninsula: ruined border keep at outer SW coast; thorn forest with huge twisted tree; thin violet rift gate; silver moon lake and crescent shrine; cyan threaded crystal mine entrance; green poison marsh with stilt alchemy hut; charred fortress with embers; small fallen floating city of gold arches and cyan waterfalls; meteor meadow with impact crater; tiny empty throne on broken violet platforms near the peninsula's northeast neck. Keep these ten together and legible, do not distribute them around the whole continent.
2 northwest alpine region, icy slate blue and snow white, immense split mountain and small unnamed mountain city.
3 north central amber steppe, ochre/copper, colossal broken circular observatory.
4 northeast crimson autumn woodland, burgundy and muted gold, ancient giant root cathedral.
5 southeast turquoise marsh delta, jade and pale sand, stepped tidal temple and a few unnamed coastal city buildings.
6 central heartland, pale gold farmland and ivory masonry, a large unnamed ring-walled city with an empty central spindle tower.
The THREAT is a thin jagged violet wound visibly originating in southwest frontier and spreading northeast into central heartland, tributary cracks thinning as they approach the ring city; bright scar edges and dark fissure, not a river, not a radial central explosion. Do not put the chapter-one throne at continent centre. Ocean, mountain chains, rivers, a few unnamed cities for future chapters. Elegant painterly chapter-select concept with strong biome palette blocks, no game interface. Warm upper-left light, cool occlusion, no characters. Deliver the whole continent, no cropped coasts.
